gloss: to persuade; to hit on, to seduce

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {口説|くど}いていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to persuade, to talk into, to win over
definitions.explanation: To persistently try to convince someone to agree or comply. Often implies repeated or prolonged attempts.

definitions.gloss: to hit on, to make a pass at, to court
definitions.explanation: To try to win someone's romantic interest through persistent attention or flattery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{口説|くど}いて⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦させた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I persuaded my friend to participate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{口説|くど}いて⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{承諾|しょうだく}して→承諾する：18993_shoudakusuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: After persuading them many times, I finally got their agreement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{口説|くど}いて⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やして→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I talked the president into increasing the project budget.

examples.japanese: ⟦バー→バー：07060_baa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{口説|くど}く。
examples.english: To hit on a woman at a bar.
He's good at hitting on people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{口説|くど}き{落|お}とした。
examples.english: He spent half a year wooing her and finally won her over.

notes:
Both senses share the nuance of persistent, repeated attempts to win someone over. Sense 2 is especially common in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口説|くど}き{落|お}とす — to successfully woo/persuade (implies success after effort)
- {口説|くど}き⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧ — pickup line, sweet talk
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{口説|くど}く — to persuade/court repeatedly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{説得|せっとく}する→説得する：21139_settokusuru⟧ — to persuade (more neutral and formal)
- ⟦ナンパ→ナンパ：09312_nanpa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to pick up, to hit on (more casual, street-oriented)
